title: Bentwaters nukes flown to Kirtland for analysis
place_text: RAF Bentwaters to Kirtland Air Force Base

tellings.quote: he was aware that shortly after this incident two tactical nuclear bombs were removed from a bunker at bentwaters flown aboard a c5a aircraft to Kirtland Air Force Base

plain: Shortly after the 1980 Rendlesham Forest incident, when US airmen in England reported a strange craft near the RAF Bentwaters base, two tactical nuclear bombs are said to have been taken from a bunker there and flown aboard a C-5A cargo plane to Kirtland Air Force Base for checks. The researcher Robert Hastings, who collects accounts of UFOs at nuclear weapons sites, tells Michels he heard this from an unnamed retired colonel in charge of NATO weapons security. If true, the military feared the craft had affected the weapons.
